opportunities.title: Get a paid summer internship in healthcare for high school students
opportunities.description: Kaiser Permanente LAUNCH Summer Youth Employment Program offers paid summer work experience at Kaiser Permanente for high school students ages 16-19. The program lasts for seven weeks and provides weekly workshops, mentoring, and networking opportunities.

schedule.notes: The program is seven weeks long. Check the website for specific dates.

properties.elig-description: 1) Current high school student; 2) Available to work full-time during the program; 3) Have permanent residence in a Northern California Kaiser Permanente service area; 4) Vaccinated for COVID-19 or have received a medical or religious exemption.
properties.cost-note: Pay is bi-weekly, $23 per hour
